verses.sloka: युद्ध्यतामेव तेषां तु तदा वानररक्षसाम् ।रविरस्तं गतो रात्रिः प्रवृत्ता प्राणहारिणी ।। ६.४४.१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yuddhyatāmeva teṣāṁ tu tadā vānararakṣasām ।ravirastaṁ gato rātriḥ pravṛttā prāṇahāriṇī ।। 6.44.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Thus, as the Vanaras and Rakshasas were battling, the Sun began to set, which is not favourable to the life of Vanaras.

verses.sloka: अन्योन्यं बद्धवैराणां घोराणां जयमिच्छताम् ।सम्प्रवृत्तं निशायुद्धं तदा वानररक्षसाम् ।। ६.४४.२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: anyonyaṁ baddhavairāṇāṁ ghorāṇāṁ jayamicchatām ।sampravṛttaṁ niśāyuddhaṁ tadā vānararakṣasām ।। 6.44.2 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Vanaras and dreadful Rakshasas being strongly inimical to each other started the night battle wishing victory.
translations.hindi: परस्पर यद्ध करते हुए वडे बलवान वानरो और राक्षसो' की सेनाएँ अत्यन्त क्रुद् हो गई | EU ते हयेः १काञ्चनापी डेधवंजेश्चाग्निशिखोपमेः । रयैश्चादित्यसङ्गाशैः कवचैश्व मनोरमैः

verses.sloka: राक्षसो ऽसीति हरयो हरिश्चासीति राक्षसाः ।अन्योन्यं समरे जघ्नुस्तस्मिंस्तमसि दारुणे ।। ६.४४.३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣaso 'sīti harayo hariścāsīti rākṣasāḥ ।anyonyaṁ samare jaghnustasmiṁstamasi dāruṇe ।। 6.44.3 ।।।।

translations.english: In the fierce darkness that prevailed, monkeys hit monkeys thinking to be Rakshasas and Rakshasas hit Rakshasas thinking to be Vanaras (not knowing in darkness) hit each other.

verses.sloka: जहि दारय चैहीति कथं विद्रवसीति च ।एवं सुतुमुलः शब्दस्तस्मिंस्तमसि शुश्रुवे ।। ६.४४.४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: jahi dāraya caihīti kathaṁ vidravasīti ca ।evaṁ sutumulaḥ śabdastasmiṁstamasi śuśruve ।। 6.44.4 ।।।।

translations.english: "Strike", "Tear", "Why are you running away?" were the kind of tumultuous echo heard in the darkness of the night. In that darkness the dark complexioned Vanaras and Rakshasas covered with golden armour in the night seemed like shining herbs of the forest in the mountain.

verses.sloka: कालाः काञ्चनसन्नाहास्तस्मिंस्तमसि राक्षसाः ।सम्प्रादृश्यन्त शैलेन्द्रा दीप्तौषधिवना इव ।। ६.४४.५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kālāḥ kāñcanasannāhāstasmiṁstamasi rākṣasāḥ ।samprādṛśyanta śailendrā dīptauṣadhivanā iva ।। 6.44.5 ।।।।

translations.english: "Strike", "Tear", "Why are you running away?" were the kind of tumultuous echo heard in the darkness of the night. In that darkness the dark complexioned Vanaras and Rakshasas covered with golden armour in the night seemed like shining herbs of the forest in the mountain.
translations.hindi: वानराणामपि चमूत् इती जयमिच्छताम्‌ | ` ` अभ्यधावत ता सेनां रसां कामरूपिणाम्‌ ॥ ४.॥ _ बानरो' की महती सेना भी जो श्रीरामचन्द्र की. जै चाहती थी, उन कामरूपी राक्षसो के ऊपर टूट पड? ॥ ४ ४ i ¬ -ङ्गञ्ायङः लणमयशेसरेः । ( गो० ) ७८ एदे एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तेषामन्योन्यमभिधावताम्‌ । रक्षसां वानराणां च इन्दव युद्व मवत

verses.sloka: तस्मिंस्तमसि दुष्पारे राक्षसाः क्रोधमूर्च्छिताः ।परिपेतुर्महावेगा भक्षयन्तः प्लवङ्गमान् ।। ६.४४.६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasmiṁstamasi duṣpāre rākṣasāḥ krodhamūrcchitāḥ ।paripeturmahāvegā bhakṣayantaḥ plavaṅgamān ।। 6.44.6 ।।।।

translations.english: In that pitch darkness, which was difficult even to move, the Rakshasas overcome by anger and lost senses were wandering devouring the monkeys.
translations.hindi: बालिपुत्र अङ्गइ के साथ महातेजस्त्री इन्द्रजीत का यद्ध वैसा हो,हुआ; जैसा कि, महादेव का युद्ध अन्तकासुर से हुआ था

verses.sloka: ते हयान् काञ्चनापीडान् ध्वजांश्चाग्निशिखोपमान् ।आप्लुत्य दशनैस्तीक्ष्णैर्भीमकोपा व्यदारयन् ।। ६.४४.७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te hayān kāñcanāpīḍān dhvajāṁścāgniśikhopamān ।āplutya daśanaistīkṣṇairbhīmakopā vyadārayan ।। 6.44.7 ।।।।

translations.english: The mighty strong Vanaras, terribly angry at the Rakshasas sprang up to the sky, and tore with their sharp teeth, the horses of Rakshasas decked with golden ornaments pervading like fire in the battle.
translations.hindi: समर में अति दुधष सम्पाति वानर प्रजङ्घ राक्षस से भिड़ गया और हनुमान जम्बुमाली राक्षस से लड़ने लगे

verses.sloka: वानरा बलिनो युद्धे ऽक्षोभयन् राक्षसीं चमूम् ।कुञ्जरान् कुञ्जरारोहान् पताकाध्वजिनो स्थान् ।चकर्षुश्च ददंशुश्च दशनैः क्रोधमूर्च्छिताः ।। ६.४४.८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vānarā balino yuddhe 'kṣobhayan rākṣasīṁ camūm ।kuñjarān kuñjarārohān patākādhvajino sthān ।cakarṣuśca dadaṁśuśca daśanaiḥ krodhamūrcchitāḥ ।। 6.44.8 ।।।।

translations.english: Having lost senses in fury they dragged the elephants, those mounted upon them, and the chariots decorated with posts and flags and tore them with their teeth.
translations.hindi: रावण के छोटे भाई बिभीषण अत्यन्त कुपित हो अति तीक्ष्ण वेग से मित्रघ नामक राक्षस से लड़ने लगे

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणश्चापि रामश्च शरैराशीविषोपमैः ।दृश्यादृश्यानि रक्षांसि प्रवराणि निजघ्नतुः ।। ६.४४.९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇaścāpi rāmaśca śarairāśīviṣopamaiḥ ।dṛśyādṛśyāni rakṣāṁsi pravarāṇi nijaghnatuḥ ।। 6.44.9 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Rama as well as Lakshmana with their venomous snakelike arrows killed both visible and invisible principal Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: तुरङ्गखुरविध्वस्तं रथनेमिसमुत्थितम् ।रुरोध कर्णनेत्राणि युद्ध्यतां धरणीरजः ।। ६.४४.१० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: turaṅgakhuravidhvastaṁ rathanemisamutthitam ।rurodha karṇanetrāṇi yuddhyatāṁ dharaṇīrajaḥ ।। 6.44.10 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the dust rose from the ground pulverised the horses' hooves and crushed by the chariot wheels, filling the ears and eyes of those in war.
translations.hindi: वानरराज सुग्रीव की और प्रचसेन की भिडन्त हुई और श्रीमान्‌ लक्ष्मण जी विरूपाक्ष से भिड़ गए

verses.sloka: वर्तमाने महाघोरे सङ्ग्रामे रोमहर्षणे ।रुधिरोदा महाघोरा नद्यस्तत्र प्रसुस्रुवुः ।। ६.४४.११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vartamāne mahāghore saṅgrāme romaharṣaṇe ।rudhirodā mahāghorā nadyastatra prasusruvuḥ ।। 6.44.11 ।।।।

translations.english: In that way as the war was going on, and rivers of blood flowing with the terrific noise it made hair stand on end.

verses.sloka: ततो भेरीमृदङ्गानां पणवानां च निस्वनः ।शङ्खवेणुस्वनोन्मिश्रः सम्बभूवाद्भुतोपमः ।। ६.४४.१२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato bherīmṛdaṅgānāṁ paṇavānāṁ ca nisvanaḥ ।śaṅkhaveṇusvanonmiśraḥ sambabhūvādbhutopamaḥ ।। 6.44.12 ।।।।

translations.english: There arose wonderful sounds of musical instruments, the sounds of kettle drums, wooden drums, mixed with conchs and flutes.
translations.hindi: भयङ्कर राच्तस वञ्चमुष्टि और अशनिप्रभ का यद्ध वानरश्रेष्ठ सैन्द और द्विविद के साथ हुआ

verses.sloka: हतानां स्तनमानानां राक्षसानां च निस्वनः ।शस्तानां वानराणां च सम्बभूवातिदारुणः ।। ६.४४.१३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hatānāṁ stanamānānāṁ rākṣasānāṁ ca nisvanaḥ ।śastānāṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca sambabhūvātidāruṇaḥ ।। 6.44.13 ।।।।

translations.english: There from the battlefield arose the roaring sounds of wounded and appeased Rakshasas and Vanaras.
translations.hindi: रणदुधेर बीर और भयङ्कर राक्षस प्रतपन ने, युद्ध में तीक्ष्ण वेग वाले नल क साथ यद्ध किआ

verses.sloka: हतैर्वानरवीरैश्च शक्तिशूलपरश्वधैः ।निहतैः पर्वताग्रैश्च राक्षसैः कामरूपिभिः ।। ६.४४.१४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hatairvānaravīraiśca śaktiśūlaparaśvadhaiḥ ।nihataiḥ parvatāgraiśca rākṣasaiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ ।। 6.44.14 ।।।।

translations.english: There with warriors of Vanaras wounded by javelins, tridents and axes, and the Rakshasas of mountain size who could change their form at will, the battlefield was muddy, and wet with blood flowing and difficult to reach.

verses.sloka: शस्त्रपुष्पोपहारा च तत्रासीद्युद्धमेदिनी ।दुर्ज्ञेया दुर्निवेशा च शोणितास्रावकर्दमा ।। ६.४४.१५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śastrapuṣpopahārā ca tatrāsīdyuddhamedinī ।durjñeyā durniveśā ca śoṇitāsrāvakardamā ।। 6.44.15 ।।।।

translations.english: There with warriors of Vanaras wounded by javelins, tridents and axes, and the Rakshasas of mountain size who could change their form at will, the battlefield was muddy, and wet with blood flowing and difficult to reach.
translations.hindi: त धर्मपुत्र बलवान महांकपि सुपेण के साथ विद्यन्माली का यद्ध हुआ ॥. १४ ॥ वानराश्चापरे भीमा राचसेरपरेः सह । वन्दं समीयुबहुधा युद्धाय बहुभिः सह

verses.sloka: सा बभूव निशा घोरा हरिराक्षसहारिणी ।कालरात्रीव भूतानां सर्वेषां दुरतिक्रमा ।। ६.४४.१६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sā babhūva niśā ghorā harirākṣasahāriṇī ।kālarātrīva bhūtānāṁ sarveṣāṁ duratikramā ।। 6.44.16 ।।।।

translations.english: Like the dreadful night for all beings, difficult to spend, as if it were a dissolution, destructive to Vanaras and Rakshasas.
translations.hindi: एक दूसरे को जीतने की'३च्छा रखनेईबाले वीर र।च्तसों और वानरों का यह महान्‌ तुसुल युद्ध रोमाञ्चकारी था

verses.sloka: ततस्ते राक्षसास्तत्र तस्मिंस्तमसि दारुणे ।राममेवाभ्यवर्तन्त संसृष्टाः शरवृष्टिभिः ।। ६.४४.१७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataste rākṣasāstatra tasmiṁstamasi dāruṇe ।rāmamevābhyavartanta saṁsṛṣṭāḥ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ ।। 6.44.17 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter in that exceedingly fearsome dark night in the battlefield highly delighted Rakshasas assailed Rama with a rain of arrows.
translations.hindi: वानरो ऑर राक्षसों के शरीरों से रक्त की नदियाँ ` बह रही थीं, जिनमें बीरों के बाल सिवार घास की तरह, और शारीर काष्ठसमूह की तरह देख पड़ते थे

verses.sloka: तेषामापततां शब्दः क्रुद्धानामपि गर्जताम् ।उद्वर्त इव सप्तानां समुद्राणां प्रशुश्रुवे ।। ६.४४.१८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāmāpatatāṁ śabdaḥ kruddhānāmapi garjatām ।udvarta iva saptānāṁ samudrāṇāṁ praśuśruve ।। 6.44.18 ।।।।

translations.english: The thundering noise of the angry Rakshasas rushing towards Rama was like the seven seas rising to flow into the ocean.
translations.hindi: इन्द्रजीत ने अत्यन्त क्रद्ध हो शत्र-सेन्य-सं हारकारी बीर अङ्गद के वैसे ही एक गंदा मारी; जैसे इन्द्र दैत्य के बज मारते हें

verses.sloka: तेषां रामः शरैष्षङ्भिष्षड् जघान निशाचरान् ।निमेषान्तरमात्रेण शितैरग्निशिखोपमैः ।। ६.४४.१९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāṁ rāmaḥ śaraiṣṣaṅbhiṣṣaḍ jaghāna niśācarān ।nimeṣāntaramātreṇa śitairagniśikhopamaiḥ ।। 6.44.19 ।।।।

translations.english: On Rama striking with the six best of shafts like flames in a time of twinkling of eyelids, the six Rakshasas, Yamasatru, Mahaparva, Mahodara, Mahakaya, and Vajradamshtra found it difficult to overcome. Along with the two Suka, Saranas all of them were struck by Rama's fire like arrows in their vital parts and escaped with leftover life.

verses.sloka: यमशत्रुश्च दुर्धर्षो महापार्श्वमहोदरौ ।वज्रदंष्ट्रो महाकायस्तौ चोभौ शुकसारणौ ।। ६.४४.२० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yamaśatruśca durdharṣo mahāpārśvamahodarau ।vajradaṁṣṭro mahākāyastau cobhau śukasāraṇau ।। 6.44.20 ।।।।

translations.english: On Rama striking with the six best of shafts like flames in a time of twinkling of eyelids, the six Rakshasas, Yamasatru, Mahaparva, Mahodara, Mahakaya, and Vajradamshtra found it difficult to overcome. Along with the two Suka, Saranas all of them were struck by Rama's fire like arrows in their vital parts and escaped with leftover life.

verses.sloka: ते तु रामेण बाणौघैः सर्वे मर्मसु ताडिताः ।युद्धादपसृतास्तत्र सावशेषायुषो ऽभवन् ।। ६.४४.२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te tu rāmeṇa bāṇaughaiḥ sarve marmasu tāḍitāḥ ।yuddhādapasṛtāstatra sāvaśeṣāyuṣo 'bhavan ।। 6.44.21 ।।।।

translations.english: On Rama striking with the six best of shafts like flames in a time of twinkling of eyelids, the six Rakshasas, Yamasatru, Mahaparva, Mahodara, Mahakaya, and Vajradamshtra found it difficult to overcome. Along with the two Suka, Saranas all of them were struck by Rama's fire like arrows in their vital parts and escaped with leftover life.
translations.hindi: रथ में बैठे हुए महावलवान्‌ जम्बुमाली ने क्रढ्ू दो रथ में सदा रखी रहने वाली. एक शक्ति ( साँग ) चला हनुमान जी की! [ छाती घायल कर दी

verses.sloka: तत्र काञ्चनचित्राङ्गैः शरैरग्निशिखोपमैः ।दिशश्चकार विमलाः प्रदिशश्च महाबलः ।। ६.४४.२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatra kāñcanacitrāṅgaiḥ śarairagniśikhopamaiḥ ।diśaścakāra vimalāḥ pradiśaśca mahābalaḥ ।। 6.44.22 ।।।।

translations.english: Mighty Rama with his shafts that were like flames of fire, decorated with gold, brightened in all directions.

verses.sloka: ये त्वन्ये राक्षसा भीमा रामस्याभिमुखे स्थिताः ।ते ऽपि नष्टाः समासाद्य पतङ्ग इव पावकम् ।। ६.४४.२३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ye tvanye rākṣasā bhīmā rāmasyābhimukhe sthitāḥ ।te 'pi naṣṭāḥ samāsādya pataṅga iva pāvakam ।। 6.44.23 ।।।।

translations.english: Those fierce Rakshasas who stood in front of Rama were destroyed like fireflies fallen in fire.
translations.hindi: राक्षस प्रतपन गर्जता हुआ जब नल की ओर दौड़ा; तब नळ ने दौड़ा कर उसके दोनों नेत्र निकाल लिए और उसे मार कर गिरा दिआ

verses.sloka: सुवर्णपुङ्खैर्विशिखैः सम्पतद्भिः सहस्रशः ।बभूव रजनी चित्रा खद्योतैरिव शारदी ।। ६.४४.२४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: suvarṇapuṅkhairviśikhaiḥ sampatadbhiḥ sahasraśaḥ ।babhūva rajanī citrā khadyotairiva śāradī ।। 6.44.24 ।।।।

translations.english: By the rain of thousands of golden feathered arrows, the night appeared as if illumined by fireflies and like a wonderful autumnal night.
translations.hindi: प्रधस नामक राक्षस शीघ्रतापूर्वक पैने पैने बांणों से सुग्रीव को घायल कर रहा था ओर बानरी सेना को निगल जाना ज्वाहता था

verses.sloka: राक्षसानां च निनदैर्हरीणां चापि निस्वनैः ।सा बभूव निशा घोरा भूयो घोरतरा तदा ।। ६.४४.२५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasānāṁ ca ninadairharīṇāṁ cāpi nisvanaiḥ ।sā babhūva niśā ghorā bhūyo ghoratarā tadā ।। 6.44.25 ।।।।

translations.english: The night which was fierce appeared more dreadful with the loud noise of Rakshasas and Vanaras.

verses.sloka: तेन शब्देन महता प्रवृद्धेन समन्ततः ।त्रिकूटः कन्दराकीर्णः प्रव्याहरदिवाचलः ।। ६.४४.२६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tena śabdena mahatā pravṛddhena samantataḥ ।trikūṭaḥ kandarākīrṇaḥ pravyāharadivācalaḥ ।। 6.44.26 ।।।।

translations.english: Resounding with the sound rising all over the caves of Trikuta mountain echoed and it looked as if the mountain was responding to someone's call.
translations.hindi: वज़मुष्टि अपने रथ और घोडा सहितं भूमि पर उसी प्रकार गिर पड़ा ; जिस प्रकार देवबिमान भूमि पर गिरता हे । विभीषण १ पुराष्ट्र- देवविमानमिव । ( रा० ) # पाठ, न्तरे“ पुराङ्ट ” ने अरिदपन्न और आक्रमणकारी फुर्तले मित्रन्र को, जिसने बिभोषण के शारीर को पैने तीरों से छेद डाला था, अपनी भारी गदा के प्रहार से मार डाला

verses.sloka: गोलाङ्गूला महाकायास्तमसा तुल्यवर्चसः ।सम्परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्यां भक्षयन् रजनीचरान् ।। ६.४४.२७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: golāṅgūlā mahākāyāstamasā tulyavarcasaḥ ।sampariṣvajya bāhubhyāṁ bhakṣayan rajanīcarān ।। 6.44.27 ।।।।

translations.english: The dark complexioned Rakshasas of gigantic body, who were highly energetic were held tightly by the monkeys with black faces and long tails and allowed them to be devoured.

verses.sloka: अङ्गदस्तु रणे शत्रुं निहन्तुं समुपस्थितः ।रावणिं निजघानाशु सारथिं च हयानपि ।। ६.४४.२८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: aṅgadastu raṇe śatruṁ nihantuṁ samupasthitaḥ ।rāvaṇiṁ nijaghānāśu sārathiṁ ca hayānapi ।। 6.44.28 ।।।।

translations.english: Angada who was determined to kill the enemies, in no time wounded Ravana's charioteer and also the horses.

verses.sloka: वर्तमाने तदा घोरे सङ्ग्रामे भृशदारुणे ।इन्द्रजित्तु रथं त्यक्त्वा हताश्वो हतसारथिः ।अङ्गदेन महाकायस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ।। ६.४४.२९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vartamāne tadā ghore saṅgrāme bhṛśadāruṇe ।indrajittu rathaṁ tyaktvā hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ ।aṅgadena mahākāyastatraivāntaradhīyata ।। 6.44.29 ।।।।

translations.english: As the violent war was going on, the great cheat, Indrajith disappeared from there as Angada had already killed his horses and charioteer.

verses.sloka: तत्कर्म वालिपुत्रस्य सर्वे देवाः सहर्षिभिः ।तुष्टुवुः पूजनार्हस्य तौ चोभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ६.४४.३० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatkarma vāliputrasya sarve devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ ।tuṣṭuvuḥ pūjanārhasya tau cobhau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 6.44.30 ।।।।

translations.english: As the violent war was going on, the great cheat, Indrajith disappeared from there as Angada had already killed his horses and charioteer.

verses.sloka: प्रभावं सर्वभूतानि विदुरिन्द्रजितो युधि ।तेन ते तं महात्मानं तुष्टा दृष्ट्वा प्रधर्षितम् ।। ६.४४.३१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: prabhāvaṁ sarvabhūtāni vidurindrajito yudhi ।tena te taṁ mahātmānaṁ tuṣṭā dṛṣṭvā pradharṣitam ।। 6.44.31 ।।।।

translations.english: Angada who was worthy of worship, was praised by even the sages, all deities and both Rama and Lakshmana for his action.
translations.hindi: युद्ध में निकुम्भ ने, काले सुरमे के ढेर की तरह शरीर वाले नील वानर को पैने पैने बाणा से ऐसा छिन्न भिन्न कर डाला; जैसे सूर्य अपनी किरणों से मेघ को छिन्न मित्र कर डालते हैं

verses.sloka: ततः प्रहृष्टाः कपयः ससुग्रीवविभीषणाः ।साधु साध्विति नेदुश्च दृष्ट्वा शत्रुं प्रधर्षितम् ।। ६.४४.३२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ kapayaḥ sasugrīvavibhīṣaṇāḥ ।sādhu sādhviti neduśca dṛṣṭvā śatruṁ pradharṣitam ।। 6.44.32 ।।।।

translations.english: All beings present in war were aware of Indrajith's deeds. Therefore, they were gratified to see him defeated.

verses.sloka: इन्द्रजित्तु तदा तेन निर्जितो भीमकर्मणा ।संयुगे वालिपुत्रेण क्रोधं चक्रे सुदारुणम् ।। ६.४४.३३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: indrajittu tadā tena nirjito bhīmakarmaṇā ।saṁyuge vāliputreṇa krodhaṁ cakre sudāruṇam ।। 6.44.33 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Sugriva, Vibheeshana and all monkeys gratified with Angada's deed cried out saying "Excellent, Well done".
translations.hindi: तब तो नील ने निकुम्भ के रथ के पहिये से, निकुम्भ का तथा उसके सारथी के सिर उसी तरह काट डाला; जिस प्रकार बिष्णु दैत्यों के सिर अपने सुदश न चक्र से काटते हैं

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रामो वानरान् वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.४४.३४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare rāmo vānarān vākyamabravīt ।। 6.44.34 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Indrajith of terrible deeds defeated by Angada in the comb at became terribly angry.
translations.hindi: वञ्ज के तुल्य मूँ का मारने वाले द्विबिद ने सब राक्षसा के सामने अशनिप्रभ राक्षस के पर्वत का शिखर मारा

verses.sloka: सर्वे भवन्तस्तिष्ठन्तु कपिराजेन सङ्गताः ।। ६.४४.३५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sarve bhavantastiṣṭhantu kapirājena saṅgatāḥ ।। 6.44.35 ।।।।

translations.english: That sinful son of Ravana, who is capable of encountering rising up remained invisible and shot sharp arrows.
translations.hindi: तब समर में पेड़ों से लड़ने वाले द्विविद को अशनिप्रभ ने भी वजतुल्य बाणों से मारा

verses.sloka: स ब्रह्मणा दत्तवरस्त्रैलोक्यं बाधते भृशम् ।भवतामर्थसिद्ध्यर्थं कालेन स समागतः ।अद्यैव क्षमितव्यं मे भवन्तो विगतज्वराः ।। ६.४४.३६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa brahmaṇā dattavarastrailokyaṁ bādhate bhṛśam ।bhavatāmarthasiddhyarthaṁ kālena sa samāgataḥ ।adyaiva kṣamitavyaṁ me bhavanto vigatajvarāḥ ।। 6.44.36 ।।।।

translations.english: The angry Rakshasa (remaining invisible) pierced arrows full of serpents all over the body of Rama and Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: बाशों से घायल होने पर, द्विविदं ने अत्यन्त क्रुद्ध हो, एक साखू का पेड़ उखाड कर, घोड़ों और रथ सहित अशनिप्रभ को सार डाला

verses.sloka: सो ऽन्तर्धानगतः पापो रावणी रणकर्कशः ।अदृश्यो निशितान् बाणान् मुमोचाशनिवर्चसः ।। ६.४४.३७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: so 'ntardhānagataḥ pāpo rāvaṇī raṇakarkaśaḥ ।adṛśyo niśitān bāṇān mumocāśanivarcasaḥ ।। 6.44.37 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasa waging war in invisible form with all beings by his supernatural powers fought with both the brothers, Rama and Lakshmana and bound them in a network of arrows.
translations.hindi: गरजता हुआ भयङ्कर राक्षस प्रपतन ज्योही नल के ऊपर दौड़ा; त्योंहीं नल ने झटपट उसकी आँखें निकाल लीं

verses.sloka: स रामं लक्ष्मणं चैव घोरैर्नागमयैः शरैः ।बिभेद समरे क्रुद्धः सर्वगात्रेषु राक्षसः ।। ६.४४.३८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa rāmaṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ caiva ghorairnāgamayaiḥ śaraiḥ ।bibheda samare kruddhaḥ sarvagātreṣu rākṣasaḥ ।। 6.44.38 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the Vanaras beheld the two brothers, tigers among men bound forcibly by the angry Rakshasas like venomous monkeys.
translations.hindi: रथ पर सवार विद्युन्माली सुवर्णभूषित बाणों से सुषेण को मार कर, वार वार गर्जे रहा था

verses.sloka: मायया संवृतस्तत्र मोहयन् राघवौ युधि ।अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानां कूटयोधी निशाचरः ।बबन्ध शरबन्धेन भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ६.४४.३९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: māyayā saṁvṛtastatra mohayan rāghavau yudhi ।adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ kūṭayodhī niśācaraḥ ।babandha śarabandhena bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 6.44.39 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the evil minded Rakshasa king's son, being incapable of getting bound in visible form, by remaining invisible, bound them deceitfully. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेचतुश्चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the forty fourth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: तौ तेन पुरुषव्याघ्रौ क्रुद्धेनाशीविषैः शरैः ।सहसा निहतौ वीरौ तदा प्रैक्षन्त वानराः ।। ६.४४.४० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tau tena puruṣavyāghrau kruddhenāśīviṣaiḥ śaraiḥ ।sahasā nihatau vīrau tadā praikṣanta vānarāḥ ।। 6.44.40 ।।।।

translations.hindi: किन्तु विद्युन्माली निशाचर बड़ी फुर्ती के साथ हाथ में गदा हे, रथ से कूद कर, जमीन पर जा खडा हुआ

verses.sloka: प्रकाशरूपस्तु यदा न शक्तस्तौ बाधितुं राक्षसराजपुत्रः ।मायां प्रयोक्तुं समुपाजगाम बबन्ध तौ राजसुतौ महात्मा ।। ६.४४.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: prakāśarūpastu yadā na śaktastau bādhituṁ rākṣasarājaputraḥ ।māyāṁ prayoktuṁ samupājagāma babandha tau rājasutau mahātmā ।। 6.44.41 ।।

translations.hindi: यह्‌ देख कपिश्रे सुपे ए कद्ध हुआ और एक बड़ी मारी शिला ले कर, विद्युन्माली की ओर झपटा
